sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in compliance of the order dated 16.01.2024, the petitioner has joined investigation and cooperated with the investigating agency.
4. Learned State counsel, on instructions from ASI Davinder Singh, does not dispute the factum of the petitioner having joined investigation and cooperated with the investigating agency.
He, on further instructions submits that the petitioner is not required for further investigation much less for his custodial interrogation.
5. In the circumstances, the petition is allowed and the interim order dated 16.01.2024 is made absolute subject to the conditions laid down in Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
Needless to say, in case the petitioner misuses the concession of bail granted to him, the State would be at liberty to seek cancellation of the bail granted to him.
